linework.observation: Bold continuous outlines define the protagonist, console banks, watertight door and handset; close to the canonical interior sample.

colour.observation: Muted gray steel, navy coveralls, cream lights and restrained green sonar traces; the earlier global red cast is corrected.

shading.observation: Broad soft cel shadows model the steel console faces and navy fabric; no photographic reflections.

character_construction.observation: Bald rounded head, nose, ears, brows and mouth remain coherent and consistent with the canonical identity.

backgrounds.observation: Enclosed sonar station with watch board, console and sealed bulkhead; believable submarine interior.

finish.observation: Clean focal hierarchy and readable panels; no visible glitches.

identity.observation: The protagonist is unmistakably bald and wears the appropriate navy coveralls.

content.observation: Handset, clipboard and sonar displays support the watch scene; no exterior porthole appears.

composition.observation: Wide full-body view leaves headroom and keeps the operator and equipment within frame.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist with focused expression at the sonar console.
regions.clothing: Dark navy coveralls and dark boots.
regions.foreground_props: Handset, clipboard, log pages and sonar screens.
regions.architecture: Watertight door, equipment cabinets and close overhead piping.
regions.distance: Console line and rear door recede naturally behind the protagonist.
regions.lighting: Warm cream work lights, muted grays and small red indicators only.
